constraints: Use authorized generated ordinary prime-order curves over prime fields.
The positive path may not construct D2, D3, G_Q, H_Q, a D2-indexed target vector, or a target-support table.
Every returned result is five signed public factor identifiers whose affine sum is independently verified.
Lattice and sparse-solver candidates require a complete certificate; an exact fallback is charged and cannot support a positive signal.
No implementation or execution is authorized while the contract is REVIEW_REQUIRED.
research_question.decision_target: Decide whether bounded or composition-labeled source variables retained in an exact five-addition circuit admit a dedicated complete root finder with a credible single-instance cost path below B^2.5 total relation work, rather than merely moving D2+D3 into a solver.
research_question.motivation: Explicit D2/D3 state, exact partitions, and exact low-dimensional translation-profile modules are now scoped negative results. A compact source description and an uneliminated addition circuit remain outside those barriers and address the generalized root-finding problem left open for prime-field index calculus.
research_question.title: Dedicated generalized root finding on bounded elliptic source circuits
